official_statement_rationale: Headline inflation at 7.44 per cent is a significant breach of our upper tolerance limit, and with food inflation surging to 11.51 per cent, the risks of second-round effects and the unanchoring of inflation expectations have reached a critical threshold. While I remain convinced that a front-loaded policy action is required to demonstrate our commitment to the 4.00 per cent target and to absorb the 120,000 crore of excess liquidity in the system, I acknowledge the emerging consensus of the Committee. In the interest of maintaining a unified front during this period of high volatility, I will align with the majority to keep the repo rate unchanged at 6.50 per cent, while underscoring that the MPC must remain vigilant and ready to act decisively should these supply-side shocks show signs of persistence or generalize into the core basket.
